what: First-visit curtain: the background-color curtain clears .2s later over .2s, revealing the canvas gradient behind it (top left → bottom right, hue and saturation of the accent color), and the center logo turns on over .3s. The brightness of the two gradient ends breathes up and down between 100% ↔ 85% separately (1s · 1.4s). After the document has fully loaded it stays 1s, then the logo turns off over .5s, the two ends fade to white and transparent over .5s (the back end .2s later), and .3s later the whole curtain disappears over .8s, then fires fx:done

options.hue · sat: Gradient hue (0~360) and saturation (%), default is the value read from --kf-accent (funds-i original 195 · 46)
options.dur · dur-end: Length of one breath at both ends (sec), default 1 · 1.4
options.hold: Seconds to stay after the whole document is received, default 1 — at 0 it clears immediately
options.once: 1 means skipped from the second time in the same tab (original is-visited cookie)

note: When the curtain lifts it fires fx:done, so hooking the hero entrance after that gives the original order (onLoadingComplete → is-tween). The canvas is drawn at the device pixel ratio

from.where: index.html .fi-loader — original .cmn-loader (canvas hsla(195, 46%, 100→85%) TweenMax yoyo 1s·1.4s, TimelineLite delay 1 → .5 · .8s)
